sections.heading: Do British citizens need a Ethiopia visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Ethiopia. Tourist visas can be applied for online as an eVisa through Ethiopia's official immigration system.

sections.heading: Ethiopia visa for other passport holders
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way. Business and work visits have their own visa types and need supporting letters.

sections.heading: Ethiopia eVisa tips
sections.text: Apply through the official government system only, as several unofficial websites charge extra. Read the UK government travel advice for Ethiopia, as it advises against travel to some areas.

sections.heading: Ethiopia visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Ethiopia visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. We check the current rules for your nationality, complete your application and keep you updated until it's approved. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Ethiopia.

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Ethiopia?
faqs.a: Yes. Tourists can apply online for an Ethiopia eVisa before travelling.

faqs.q: Can I get an Ethiopia business visa online?
faqs.a: Business visas have different requirements, including a letter from the Ethiopian company. We confirm the current process before you apply.

faqs.q: How long does a Ethiopia visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.
